Dana Durand LMT, BCTMB, is a graduate of the Baltimore School of Massage in the Professional Medical Massage Program. She has been practicing since 2002 and owns a massage studio in Rockville, Maryland. Dana also is the founder of Healing Touch Studies, a massage therapy education program. She has been dedicating her time at home these past few weeks to making YouTube videos for people to practice fun and stress relieving at-home massage techniques.

https://www.danadurand.com
https://www.healingtouchstudies.com
